description.value: A 1962 Wabco 50-ton Haulpak mining truck preserved as an outdoor static display in Ashcroft, British Columbia, representing the region's industrial and copper-mining heritage. At roughly 50 tonnes capacity, these massive haul trucks were workhorses of mid-twentieth-century open-pit mining operations. It functions as a roadside heritage landmark and photo opportunity rather than a staffed attraction.
